messages:
Lena (docs): Quick heads-up: the /generate response examples in openapi use inconsistent discriminator keys ("type" vs "variant") which makes the JS SDK generator choose the wrong oneOf branch. Also the upload curl snippet is missing an explicit multipart boundary, so copy/paste fails in bash.

Owen (eng-runtime): thanks, can you paste the bad example lines?

Lena (docs): Sure: https://github.com/redwood-inference/api/blob/main/openapi/generate.yaml#L704-L725 . Proposed minimal change: normalize examples to include "variant". Example for chat branch: { "variant": "chat", "messages": [{ "role": "assistant", "content": "Hi" }] }

Priya (sdk): Our generator expects a discriminator named "variant". Docs change only is lowest-risk. Also ask that the docs include a Node FormData snippet for upload so copy/paste aligns with SDK samples.

Lena (docs): For curl I'll add an explicit boundary example so people can copy/paste: curl -X POST "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/upload" -H "Content-Type: multipart/form-data; boundary=----RdwdBoundary" --data-binary $'------RdwdBoundary\r\nContent-Disposition: form-data; name="file"; filename="a.txt"\r\nContent-Type: text/plain\r\n\r\nhello\r\n------RdwdBoundary--'

Owen (eng-runtime): SGTM. I'll open a tiny PR that updates the examples and adds a one-line note in docs/migration.md so integrators know examples now include the discriminator. No runtime changes.

bot-docs: PR #5112 opened by owen: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5112 - updates examples to use "variant", fixes multipart curl snippet, adds Node FormData example and migration note. CI: docs-lint OK.

Priya (sdk): I'll run the sample-generator test once the PR lands to validate snippets.

Lena (docs): thanks all, I'll review once merged and spot-check staging.
